goal: Deliver the complete local Mac/Linux Valkey lifecycle with exact real 50-node and 200-node execution, attributable evidence, deterministic cleanup, and validated offline reporting.

criteria.statement: Local scenarios, configuration, scale selection, and plans are schema-backed, deterministic, exact, and fail closed instead of silently downscaling.
The local runtime creates owned Valkey resources, executes the complete lifecycle, preserves exact topology, and cleans every owned resource deterministically.
Management, workload, fault, failover, recovery, and stability behavior remains bounded, observable, and confined to project-owned resources.
Lifecycle artifacts and provenance are complete and reject missing, substituted, relabelled, stale, or fabricated evidence.
Offline analysis and reports derive only from validated artifacts and preserve missing-data and workload-impact semantics.
A real local full-flow run requests and independently observes exactly 50 healthy Valkey 9.1.x nodes and completes cleanup.
A real local full-flow run requests and independently observes exactly 200 healthy Valkey 9.1.x nodes and completes cleanup.
